responsibility: Declares the dedicated Rust AST path resolver. ResolvePath provides focused entry points for resolving expression paths, qualified expression paths, and simple paths against the current Resolver state, separating path-segment lookup and generic-argument handling from the broader expression and type visitors that invoke it.
same_name_distinction: Declares the dedicated ResolvePath helper and its overloads for resolving expression and simple-path forms. Unlike the matching .cc file, it only exposes the path-resolver entry points and private helper signatures, not the lookup algorithm itself.
